memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "Do not allow a sorceress to live." - Exodus 22:18 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
This is a startling and severe command, and we must understand it rightly. It was given to Israel as a nation under God's direct rule, at a time when sorcery meant deliberately reaching into dark spiritual powers in defiance of the living God. It was a form of spiritual treason that could poison the whole community. We do not live under Israel's civil law today, and this is not a licence for anyone now — the New Testament calls us instead to pray for and reach out to those trapped in such things.

But the enduring truth remains: God takes seriously the danger of the occult. Turning to sorcery, witchcraft, or dark spiritual practices is not a harmless curiosity or a bit of fun. It means seeking power and guidance from sources opposed to God, and it can entangle a soul in real bondage. God's fierce stance here is not cruelty; it is the protectiveness of a Father warning His children away from something genuinely destructive.

The good news is that Christ has triumphed over every dark power (Col 2:15). We need not fear these forces, nor dabble in them for a sense of control or insight. In Jesus we have all the guidance, security, and power we could ever need. If you have been entangled in such things, know that His light is stronger than any darkness, and His grace can set you completely free.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
Am I tempted to seek control or guidance from sources other than God?
Do I truly believe Christ's power is greater than any darkness?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, You have triumphed over every dark power through Christ. Keep me from seeking control or insight anywhere but in You, and free anyone bound by darkness. Amen.
